01 — Overview

Strata Notch quietly merges with your top bezel. Hover, pull down, or drag a file toward the top of your screen — and it morphs into a luminous Liquid Glass control hub, then melts back into the dark.

02 — Island States & Themes

Ambient by default.
Expansive on command.

01

Dormant Bezel Modes

A click-through overlay aligned to your notch. Choose from 7 ambient modes — Live Clock + Battery, Weather, Minimal Battery Dot, System Pulse or completely hidden.

03 — The Expanded Hub

Six tabs. Every tool.
Right under the notch.

01 · Home

A glance that greets you.

Time-aware greeting, Now Playing mini-player, local weather card, direct volume & display brightness sliders, and your next calendar event within 24 hours.

02 · Media

Every player. One remote.

Controls Apple Music, Spotify and 11 web browsers — Safari, Chrome, Arc, Brave, Edge and more. Scrub the timeline, jump to the source app, and watch the live 6-bar FFT spectrum.

03 · Shelf & AirDrop

Drop files at the top edge.

Drag any file near the notch to auto-open the persistent File Shelf and dedicated AirDrop zone — plus a real-time ~/Downloads watcher with live progress.

04 · Focus

Deep work, on tap.

Sleep-proof Timer, Pomodoro and Stopwatch alongside a password-safe Clipboard history, quick-notes Scratchpad, Shortcuts runner and 1-click macOS Focus mode bar.

05 · Weather

Hyper-local forecast, zero API keys.

Powered by Open-Meteo with GPS and automatic IP fallback. Inspect current temperature, feels-like, high/low, wind speed, humidity and a 4-hour outlook.

06 · System & EQ

Vital signs & 10-band sound.

A live 2×2 telemetry grid for CPU load, memory pressure, Wi-Fi throughput (`↓`/`↑`) & RSSI, and charger wattage — plus quick utilities and a 10-band Bluetooth EQ.

Lives in your bezel.
Never in your way.

Non-activating, click-through and auto-hiding in fullscreen. It never steals focus from the app you’re working in.

06 — Gestures & Shortcuts

Made for your fingertips.

Hover

Opens the hub with a configurable 0.15–0.80s delay.

Pull down

Siri-style drag from the top bezel to expand.

Two-finger swipe

Glide between tabs inside the hub.

Drag a file

Shelf & AirDrop targets appear automatically.

07 — Privacy

No analytics. No telemetry. No accounts. Everything runs locally on your Mac.

AccessibilityAutomationSystem AudioCameraCalendarsLocationDownloads

Permissions are requested only when you enable the module that needs them — with a built-in diagnostics checklist in Settings.
